occasion: A feed that needs volume, and a story that needs only to be published.
tell: Written by no one, read by millions
counter: Ask who wrote it and who would correct it. A byline and a corrections policy are the two things slop cannot fake for long.

confused_with.tell: The algodemic believes the nonsense; the slopagandist bills for it.

senses: The pattern of publishing at the speed of the feed: the claim generated, the byline optional, the correction never written because nobody was accountable for the piece.
It works because volume beats verification on a time budget - a fact-checker answers one item while the pipeline ships twenty - so the race is lost before it is run.
example: *"Twelve accounts, one prompt, four hundred posts a day - the **slopagandist** doesn't believe the story, he just ships it."*
